lastCompletedStory.title: Docs: mandate backlog derivation via cam issue list --json only

nextStoryContext: US-004 replaced the raw scripts/cam/issues/*.json stage-filtered fallback with an explicit `cam issue list` / `cam issue list --json` mandate + prohibition on raw issue-file reads, in THREE literal surfaces that all restate the same rule: the persona doc (.claude/agents + templates/agents subagent-orchestrator.md boot-context step 5), the /cam-issue.md list subcommand doc (.claude/commands + templates/commands, byte-identical pair), and buildOrchestratorBootPrompt()'s literal array-of-strings prompt in src/commands/run.ts (a THIRD surface not listed in the story notes' file list, discovered by grepping for the old fallback phrase after editing the docs -- fixed in this story too since leaving it would defeat the incident-prevention purpose). Two existing tests (test/run.test.ts, test/vendor/orchestrator-backlog-derivation.test.ts) pinned the OLD wording and were updated in the same commit rather than left red. File-size budget raised for src/commands/run.ts (790->792) and test/run.test.ts (960->962). No scripts/cam/issues/ files touched (verified via git diff --name-only). This was a docs/prompt-only story: no external library was exercised, so officialDocsValidated records lib:none. Nothing else queued for the next implementer beyond the standard PRD priority scan.
